12.    ORDINANCE 3fh READING To amend the Official Zoning Map of the Cheyenne
                                        —




       Unified Development Code, for property located east of South Greeley Highway and north
       of Chalk Bluff Road in Cheyenne, Wyoming, changing the zoning classification from HI
       (Heavy Industrial) and AG (Agricultural) to BP (Business Park).

Dr. Aldrich moved to approve on 3H1 and final reading, seconded by Mr. White. Motion carried
by unanimous voice vote.

Connor White. Planning & Development Department Senior Planner, provided a staff report and
advised there have been no changes since approval on reading.

15.    LEASES/CONTRACTS/LEGAL:

       d)       Fence Installation and Access License Agreement between the City of Cheyenne
                and Richard Menkin for fence installation on City-owned property described as Lot
                6. Block 3. Campstool Addition. 3” Filing. City of Cheyenne. Laramie County,
                Wyoming.

Dr. Aldrich moved to approve, seconded by Dr. Emmons. Motion carried by unanimous voice
vote.

Wes Bay. City Drainage Engineer, provided a staff report and committee member Aldrich
commented on the item.

There being no further items for the agenda to come before the Public Services Committee, the
meeting was adjourned at 12:10 p.m.

Submitted by,
4,. 73St
Jennifer McClelland
Executive Assistant to the Cheyenne City Council
